metadata.title: Use a Helper Module
metadata.description: Import a provided helper module and reuse its format_name function instead of rewriting it.

instructions.main: `helper.py` lives in the workspace and defines `format_name(text)`. Import it and print `helper.format_name("ada lovelace grace hopper")`.
steps: The output is `Ada Lovelace Grace Hopper` — the capitalisation comes from the module, not from your own code.

hints.message: Start with `import helper`, then `print(helper.format_name("ada lovelace grace hopper"))`.
`format_name` already lives in `helper.py` — don't rewrite it. `import helper` and call `helper.format_name(...)` so every program shares one implementation.

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: You reused the seeded helper module instead of rewriting its logic.

test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Print `helper.format_name("ada lovelace grace hopper")` — the result is `Ada Lovelace Grace Hopper`.
Reuse the provided module: `import helper` at the top, then call `helper.format_name(...)`.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: helper.py is still in the workspace.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Keep the provided `helper.py` in the workspace — import and reuse it; don't delete or replace it.
